thread:
Noah (People Ops): Looking for a tiny, copyable manager card that ties OKRs to hiring and development time. Needs to fit in a calendar note and be usable for fast 1:1s.
Asha: Nice idea. Add a single line that links the goal to hiring/bar or mentorship so hiring ops can see impact.
Derek: Draft that still keeps 6 lines per goal:
```
Goal: one-line outcome + metric (e.g., Reduce avg inference latency by 10%)
Why: 1 sentence connecting customer/business impact
Sprint commits: 2 items (owner + ETA) | Dev/mentoring time: 1h/mo
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers/deps (owner + ETA)
Hiring/skill signal: 1-line note (e.g., needs SRE help, shows leadership in triage)
Ask from manager: decision / unblock / mentoring request
```
Rina: For calibration add a private copy line: "Outcome / Signals / Suggested level" so managers can paste into calibration doc quickly.
Derek: Also add a tiny feedback script managers can use: "Evidence -> Impact -> Next step" with sample: "When you did X I observed Y; that caused Z. Try A next time."
Noah (People Ops): Can we add a bit about benefits/time-off planning? e.g., when a goal spans parental leave or comp time, note coverage plan.
Asha: Yes, add a one-line coverage plan field: "Coverage: owner + dates" so performance cycle reviewers see continuity plans.
HiringBot: Tip: If goal has hiring implications, append the 1-line hiring signal to the requisition notes to speed recruiter alignment.
Noah (People Ops): Great. I'll publish this as the "manager pocket card" and add an example bundle for eng and product teams. Pilot volunteers?
Derek: I'll pilot with my squad next week and report back.
Rina: Happy to pilot too.
Noah (People Ops): Thanks team ":rocket:" — final version will be posted in the performance kickoff doc.
